# Carnet

> To-do list backed by the visitor's own Puter account: works offline-first in localStorage signed out, syncs across browsers via puter.kv signed in, merging per task with tombstoned deletes

- Live: https://carnet.neorgon.com/
- Part of the Neorgon tool suite (free, no signup, runs in your browser): https://neorgon.com/
- Keywords: todo, tasks, puter, cloud-sync, user-pays, offline-first, static-site
